evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search basis (fingerprinting) not substantially contained in other search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search is different from fingerprinting, similar-users search, and recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-users basis for search is distinct from profile-only search and from recommendation (push) stories.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity search anchored to a given music video is not the same requirement as generic fingerprinting or metadata-based discovery.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-driven discovery is distinct from fingerprinting, profile, similar-users, or content-similarity-from-video stories.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag upload/availability is a different requirement than searching, viewing thumbnails, or admin filtering.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI viewing of thumbnail sequences is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with ZO-009, which also requests info about similar video items/segments; 'perceptually' does not create a meaningful separate requirement here.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates ZO-008's requirement to get info about similar video items/segments; difference is not clearly meaningful in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation (push) based on similar profiles is distinct from search-based discovery stories and from news-event recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News-event/location-based recommendation is distinct from similar-profile recommendation (ZO-010).

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a distinct entity type compared to products/logos/brands stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from persons, logos, and brands requirements.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is distinct from generic brand or product identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is not clearly the same as products or broadcaster logos; treated as a separate entity type.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation is distinct from profile/news-based recommendations and from map-based access.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based browsing/notification is not duplicated by other search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is distinct from other search mechanisms in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is distinct from annotation, filtering, or copyright validation.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Topic extraction/annotation differs from segmentation editing (ZO-019) and from filtering/prefiltering stories.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Quality-based filtering/ranking is distinct from nudity/copyright/asset-info prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit detection is distinct from other admin filtering and from audio noise removal.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a distinct business rule compared to other prefiltering criteria.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset-info prefiltering differs from high-level metadata/tag prefiltering (ZO-026).

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is distinct from nudity or asset-information prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter ... using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset-info prefiltering (ZO-024).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Interest/appeal/complexity assessment is distinct from prompting scientists (ZO-028) or other classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is distinct from merely assessing interestingness (ZO-027).

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is distinct from weighting classifications by experience (ZO-043).

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is distinct from Snapshot Serengeti and Plankton Portal preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty/none-animal detection is distinct from species/attribute/number preclassification in the same domain.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp malfunction is distinct from animal detection/preclassification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification differs from attribute preclassification and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species preclassification (ZO-033) and number detection (ZO-035).

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is distinct from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization is distinct from detecting empty images, size/orientation, or species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty/no-plankton detection is distinct from segmentation and species/size tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is distinct from plankton species preclassification (ZO-039) and segmentation (ZO-036).

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from size/orientation detection and segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for duration reduction is distinct from egg-laying time detection (ZO-041).

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying event time detection is distinct from general motion analysis/duration reduction (ZO-040).

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite images is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by experience is distinct from identifying volunteer types (ZO-029) and from interruption/education decisions.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal prefiltering is distinct from moving/transient object detection (ZO-045).

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal (ZO-044).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is distinct from whale-call grouping/counting and from detecting edited audio (ZO-022).

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar calls is distinct from counting whales in an audio file (ZO-048).

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales is distinct from grouping similar calls (ZO-047).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing decision for interruption is distinct from modality selection (ZO-050) and from education decisions (ZO-051/ZO-052/ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption modality selection is distinct from deciding when to interrupt (ZO-049).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing decision for education is distinct from education modality selection (ZO-052) and content selection (ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality selection is distinct from deciding when to educate (ZO-051).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education content selection is distinct from education timing (ZO-051) and modality (ZO-052).

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from deciding when Zoonibot should comment/explain/say something (ZO-055/ZO-056/ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot-comment timing is distinct from bot-explanation timing (ZO-056) and bot message content (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Bot-explanation timing is distinct from bot-comment timing (ZO-055) and bot message content (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Bot utterance/content selection is distinct from deciding when to comment or explain (ZO-055/ZO-056).

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity grouping is distinct from recommending projects to volunteers (ZO-059) and from other media similarity stories.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation based on volunteer experience is distinct from grouping subjects (ZO-058) and from earlier user content recommendation stories (different domain/actor).

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is not duplicated elsewhere in the backlog.
